info.title: Auth host HTTP API
info.description:
Host-only HTTP operations of the stock auth service. These six routes exist only on the loopback listener and return 404 on the public listener. The owner-private auth-service discovery record supplies its port and exchange capability. Every operation requires the exact Authorization bearer capability, application/json and no Origin header. Requests match the exact target, so query strings and trailing slashes return 404. Bodies default to 65536 bytes. More than 30 invalid capability attempts in a rolling minute receive 429.

The loopback listener also serves /health, /jwks, /exchange, /manager-service-authority, /manager-instances, /service-endpoint-authority, /service-endpoint-host and /chat-session/open, /chat-session/bearer, /chat-session/retire. Their public request and response shapes are in the [Auth HTTP API](https://docs.cotal.ai/api/auth/). Proof operations additionally require the loopback capability. The loopback /health handler also accepts other methods. Elevated exchange views and operator host operations are loopback-only. Mesh discovery is public-listener-only. This implementation reference does not establish a stable cloud API.

servers.description: The owner-private auth-service discovery record supplies the actual loopback port.

port.description: Example only. Replace with the port announced by the running service or its owner-private discovery record.

post.description: Retire one exact interactive actor lifecycle before rotating or deleting its grant. Unknown actors return 404 and a mismatched current lifecycle returns 409. Refusals before the retirement barrier begins carry outcome not-executed. A later failure without an outcome must be treated as unknown.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request fields.

403.description: An Origin header or failed authority/proof check is refused.

429.description: Invalid-capability attempts exceeded the rolling-minute limit.

409.description: The requested lifecycle is not current.

default.description: A native refusal uses its HTTP status and may include code and outcome. Unexpected failures use the handler error classification.

post.description: Activate the exact host-issued lifecycle UID. accountPublicKey must name this authority or the request returns 403 before mutation. Native already-exists is 409. Native refusals preserve code, outcome and optional details. An unexpected failure returns 500 with outcome unknown.

post.description: Complete terminal retirement of an exact managed lifecycle after its grant was revoked. This host recovery door is used when the responsible remote manager is gone.

post.description: Verify enrollment, retirement preparation, runtime creation or runtime status. Forward the participant request verbatim. The host derives the interactive actor scope from its own ledger; the caller cannot supply scope.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request fields.

403.description: An Origin header or failed authority/proof check is refused.

429.description: Invalid-capability attempts exceeded the rolling-minute limit.

post.description: Verify a signed password proof no older than five minutes against the authenticated session subject. The verified subject must equal subject. The owner is derived from the verified IdP proof; it is not accepted from the body.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid request fields.

403.description: An Origin header or failed authority/proof check is refused.

429.description: Invalid-capability attempts exceeded the rolling-minute limit.

post.description: Issue signed consent for the exact holder and target after verifying a fresh human proof. This route never returns private result content. ttlMs is bounded to 24 hours. Source parser and contract are packages/core/src/private-tool-results.ts and implementations/auth/src/tool-result-consent.ts.

400.description: Malformed input or any request-body read failure, including a body over 65536 bytes.

403.description: An Origin header or failed authority/proof check is refused.

429.description: Invalid-capability attempts exceeded the rolling-minute limit.

409.description: The consent ID is already recorded.

503.description: Consent signer is unavailable or issuance outcome is unknown.

HostCapability.description: Exact exchange capability from the owner-private auth-service discovery record. This is not an IdP JWT or actor bearer.

ManagedDecisionRequest.description: Native requests from packages/core/src/remote-manager-authority.ts. Forward verbatim; the host derives caller scope from its ledger.
